what: Reproducibility replay (round 3b, audit item 11): the two same-weight Qwen2.5-VL 7B comparison groups that did not reproduce between desktop and laptop, rerun on the desktop with vision_eval.run_case unchanged, protocol vision-v1-replay.
reading: Every case scored identically to the stored desktop rows, so the desktop side is deterministic run to run. The cross-machine discrepancy is machine-specific (runtime or build), not run-to-run noise. The laptop replay (Codex, docs/round3/CODEX_TASKS_3B.md item 2) decides whether the laptop side is also stable.
note: The first run's agreement summary crashed on failed rows stored as JSON null after all 260 cases were scored; the summary was recomputed from the stored rows with --summary-only. No model call was repeated.
